acceptance.given: A submitted quality contract contains a misspelled schema_version that does not identify a supported version.

oracle.expected: The validator rejects the contract and reports an invalid or unsupported schema-version diagnostic.
forbidden: The validator accepts the misspelled schema version.
The typo is treated as a supported version.
oracle.observable: Validator status and schema-version diagnostic produced while processing the contract.

acceptance.then: The contract is rejected for the invalid schema version.
acceptance.when: The versioned quality-contract validator processes the submitted contract and evaluates schema_version activity by its validation path.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the schema-version typo case through the validator and observe a rejection diagnostic naming the unsupported or invalid version.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reject misspelled or unsupported schema_version values during quality-contract validation.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Validation behavior change only; supported schema versions remain accepted.

slice_hint.state_transition: A contract with a schema-version typo moves from submitted to rejected with a schema-version error.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The validator returns failure and exposes an invalid or unsupported schema-version diagnostic for the typo case.

acceptance.given: A submitted quality contract contains a reference that cannot be resolved.

oracle.expected: The validator rejects the contract and reports an unresolved-reference diagnostic.
forbidden: The validator accepts an unresolved reference.
The unresolved reference is silently retained as resolved.
oracle.observable: Validator status and unresolved-reference diagnostic produced during reference evaluation.

acceptance.then: The contract is rejected because one or more references cannot be resolved.
acceptance.when: The versioned quality-contract validator processes the contract and evaluates reference resolution.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the unresolved-reference fixture case and observe validator failure identifying the unresolved reference.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reject contracts containing references that cannot be resolved.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Reference-resolution validation remains backward compatible for resolvable references.

slice_hint.state_transition: A contract with an unresolved reference moves from submitted to rejected with an unresolved-reference error.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The validator returns failure and exposes an unresolved-reference diagnostic for the fixture case.

acceptance.given: A valid quality contract explicitly declares one or more capabilities.

oracle.expected: The processed contract or validation result contains a capabilities record matching the declarations.
forbidden: Capabilities are inferred without an explicit declaration record.
oracle.observable: Accepted contract/result payload and its capabilities field after processing.

acceptance.then: Capabilities are explicitly represented in the accepted contract or validation result.
acceptance.when: The validator processes the valid contract and records its declared capabilities.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the valid-capability case and assert that the returned contract/result explicitly records the declared capabilities.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Record declared capabilities explicitly in the processed quality-contract result.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Result-shape extension preserves validation status and remains compatible with consumers that ignore the capabilities field.

slice_hint.state_transition: A valid declared-capability contract moves from validated input to a result containing explicit capabilities.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Validation succeeds and the result capabilities field equals the contract's declared capabilities.

acceptance.given: The skill-authoring standard is defined or evaluated against its governing requirement.

oracle.expected: The normative standard content declares exactly one primary responsibility.
forbidden: The standard omits a primary responsibility.
The standard declares multiple competing primary responsibilities.
oracle.observable: The standard document's parsed responsibility declaration during governance review.

acceptance.then: One primary responsibility is defined and uniquely identifiable.
acceptance.when: A governance review inspects the standard's responsibility declaration and checks its uniqueness.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the governance review against a standard fixture missing or duplicating the primary responsibility and observe review failure.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Define and validate one unique primary responsibility for the skill-authoring standard.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Governance-document change only; no runtime or persisted-schema compatibility impact.

slice_hint.state_transition: The standard moves from undefined or ambiguous responsibility to one declared primary responsibility.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Governance review identifies exactly one primary responsibility in the evaluated standard.
